librarygames/tower-defense/Defense.xtl

Tower defense's rules, a library: tower-defense.xtl (scripted), play.xtl (the game: clicks, keys and the clock) and the web page all use these. Built on lib/Ecs: the creeps, the towers and their shots are rows of one world, and every rule is a system over all of them at once. The game is 2D underneath (a grid of tiles and a road) and drawn in 2.5D: an isometric god's-eye view, every point of the board turned into the picture by one linear map (and a click turned back by its inverse). A game's state is a tuple: (the world, the money, the lives, the waves begun, the creeps still to come, the seconds to the next, the tower picked to build, the view (0 the board, 1 the grimoire), the grimoire's page, the seconds played, how it stands: 0 playing, 1 every wave beaten, 2 no lives left; how fast the game runs (1, 2 or 4 times), and what the last click or key did).

source · imports ec: lib/Ecs.xtl lib/Ecs.xtlm; sv: lib/Svg.xtl; t: lib/Text.xtl

The data

ʰw̲orld : Int -> Float

function (private) · line 25

The layout: where it is (x then y, in tiles), what kind (1 to 3) and level, how far a creep has come along the road, its hit points, the seconds it is slowed, a tower's seconds to its next shot, a shot's target (an entity), damage, splash and chill, and what it is.

ʰh̲asPos : (Num a, Truthy b) => a -> b

function (private) · line 25

ʰs̲hift : Int -> Int -> Int

function (private) · line 40

The road's tiles in order, from S to E: every road tile's distance to E by a flood (each one more than its nearest road neighbor, all at once, until nothing changes), then the tiles sorted by it, farthest first. The road is one path, so that order is the way along it.

ʰs̲hift ← { d k →
  k > 0 ? (k d̲rop d) c̲at k r̲eshape FAR
  ((n̲eg k) r̲eshape FAR) c̲at ((t̲ally d) + k) t̲ake d
}

ʰf̲ly ← { W dt →

  S ← s s̲elect ʰp̲os W
  D ← ((f̲loor s s̲elect ʰt̲arget W) s̲elect ʰp̲os W) − S

  0 = t̲ally hs ? W

ˡt̲ick : (Any a, Num b, Any c, Num d, Num e, Any f) => (Float, Int, Int, Int, Int, Float, a, b, c, Float, d, e, f) -> Float -> (Float, Int, Int, Int, Int, Float, a, b, c, Float, d, e, f)

function · line 232

A tick of the clock, dt seconds: the next creep comes, the creeps come along the road, the towers shoot, the shots fly and hit, the beaten creeps pay; each a system over every entity at once. While the grimoire is open the board waits (only the time moves, for its turning pictures). A game over stays as it is.

ˡt̲ick ← { s dt →
  (W, mo, lv, wv, q, tm, sel, md, pg, t, st, sp, ms) ← s
  st > 0 ? s
  md = 1 ? (W, mo, lv, wv, q, tm, sel, md, pg, t + dt, st, sp, ms)
  d ← dt × f̲loat sp
  (W, q, tm) ← ʰs̲pawning (W, q, tm − d)
  (W, lost) ← W ʰc̲rawl d
  W ← (W ʰa̲im d) ʰf̲ly d
  (W, won) ← ʰb̲eaten W
  lv ← lv − lost
  (W, mo + won, lv, wv, q, tm, sel, md, pg, t + d, ʰo̲utcome (lv, wv, q, W), sp, ms)
}

A box standing on the board: its middle (x, y), half its width, its height, and its corners turned by a (radians) about the middle; the two faces toward the viewer and the top.

ʰb̲ox ← { (x, y, w, z, a, kind) →
  u ← (a + 0.25 × p̲i @) + 0.5 × (p̲i @) × 0.0 1.0 2.0 3.0
  cx ← x + w × 1.414 × c̲os u
  cy ← y + w × 1.414 × s̲in u
  i ← g̲rade n̲eg cx + cy
  near ← 3 t̲ake i
  l ← 2 t̲ake near
  r ← (f̲irst near) c̲at 3 s̲elect near
  col ← '{ j → e̲nclose d̲isclose j s̲elect kind s̲elect FACES } e̲ach 1 2 3
  zs ← 0.0 0.0 c̲at z c̲at z
  left ← ʰp̲oly ((l s̲elect cx) c̲at r̲ev l s̲elect cx, (l s̲elect cy) c̲at r̲ev l s̲elect cy, zs, d̲isclose 2 s̲elect col)
  right ← ʰp̲oly ((r s̲elect cx) c̲at r̲ev r s̲elect cx, (r s̲elect cy) c̲at r̲ev r s̲elect cy, zs, d̲isclose 3 s̲elect col)
  top ← ʰp̲oly (cx, cy, 4 r̲eshape z, d̲isclose f̲irst col)
  left c̲at right c̲at top
}
